verdict.rationale: First-party OneDrive docs state that OneDrive enables real-time coauthoring of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files, which covers docs, sheets, and slides through the Office integration. The pack never says this co-editing happens in the browser or describes how the integration works, so only part of the story is documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of in-browser editing (e.g., Office for the web), integration documentation detailing how co-editing works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time co-editing.

support.subject: As an operations lead, documents are editable in place — real-time co-editing of docs/sheets/slides in the browser, native or via a documented integration

citations.quote: OneDrive enables real-time coauthoring in familiar apps like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
OneDrive users can access their files from any device, online or offline
